scene: You cross the stone bridge onto a bustling rooftop spice bazaar.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view along a tiled rooftop bazaar. On the far left, a spice vendor's cart holds a bowl of blue powder. Left-centre, the silver-haired grandmother in her pink tracksuit stands holding her white dog's lead. In the centre, a mechanical monkey sits on a barrel. On the far right stands a curtained tea pavilion.
shown: an open brass bowl of glowing blue powder sitting on the far left
a brass wind-up monkey perched on a wooden barrel in the centre
a curtained doorway glowing with pink paper lanterns on the far right
